title: Resigning from a job: giving notice, final pay and holiday pay
version: Employment New Zealand pages 'Resignation' (last modified 30 October 2026), 'Notice periods' (last modified 30 October 2026) and 'Final pay' (last modified 2 November 2026), all read 18 Nov 2026
sourceNote: Three pages from Employment New Zealand, the NZ Government's official employment site: Resignation (when and how to resign, putting it in writing, the employer must accept it, the notice period, starting a new job, heat-of-the-moment resignations, withdrawing, and a short pointer on constructive dismissal), Notice periods (how much notice, reasonable notice, changing the notice period, pay and leave during notice, payment in lieu and garden leave, not giving enough notice), and Final pay (when it must be paid, notice and pay, public holidays after the last day, annual holiday pay and the 8%, alternative holidays, sick leave not paid out, what to do if final pay is wrong). There is no separate 'holiday pay when employment ends' page: that guidance is on the Final pay page. The site blocks direct download here and no browser was available, so every line was read by a fetch tool asked to quote exact sentences. Key lines (notice periods, 21 days, 2 to 4 weeks, pay day of the final pay period, 8%, 12 months, the phone number) were confirmed exact in a second read, but small wording slips are possible. Gaps in the copy: some words that are links on the Final pay page did not come through and are marked [link words missing]. The labels on the two annual holiday cases also did not come through: the first case (8% of all gross earnings) seems to be for under 12 months and the second (remaining holidays plus 8% since the last anniversary) for 12 months or more, but that is inferred, not quoted. One line on the Resignation page reads 'For example, or payment in lieu of notice.' (a word may be missing on the page). Two example dates may be wrong on the pages themselves: Notice periods gives 4 weeks' notice on 'Monday 25 May' ending 'Friday 21 June', and the Final pay Jason example has 'Friday 16 October' and Labour Day on 'Monday 24 October', which can't both fall in the same year. Left out: navigation, link lists, contact boxes, the resignation letter template, the redundancy part of Notice periods, and the separate Annual holiday pay page. Saving the three pages as PDFs into sources/ would make checking exact.
status: Reviewer: 8 instructions missed (incl. full notice pay if the employer wants you gone early), all added. 187 of 187 quotes exact (web copy).
